text:
lara: Hey folks, cooking up a tiny, opinionated set of manager-ready copyblocks for midcycle handoffs + self-review craft. Goal: <140 char> evidence lines, a metric anchor, and a single-line risk/next-step. Keep it pasteable.
mitra: love short. could we add a tiny "why it mattered" sentence so calibrators get context?
theo: also add a 1-line coach prompt managers can use in 1:1s.
jen: dropping examples below. put them in handbook as a single snippet page and link from the review form.
hr-bot: Heads-up: self-review window opens Monday. Calendar invites with calibration slots were sent.

```
Project evidence line (user narrative style, 120-140 chars):
- Shipped [feature] to [audience] to enable [user action], resulting in [top-level outcome].
Metric anchor (single token):
- KPI: [metric] = [baseline] -> [current] (delta: [+X% / -Y%])
Risk / next-step (one line):
- Risk: [short cause] | Next: [owner/@name] will [action] by [date]

People enablement line (for growth/craft goals):
- Coaching impact: Ran [workshop/mentoring] with [N] peers; observed [behavior change/metric].
Why it mattered (single line):
- Why: Reduced handoff friction / sped onboarding / improved launch confidence for [team].

Manager coaching prompt (single-sentence, to use in 1:1):
- Try: "Tell me one thing you think blocked progress and one thing we should keep doing."

Short handoff tag set (comma-sep for trackers):
- tags: ownership-assigned, docs-linked, dashboards-ok, onboarding-call, known-blockers

Micro-checklist for handoffs (paste into issue description):
- [ ] Owner: @NAME
- [ ] Short evidence line + KPI anchor added
- [ ] Link to runbook / design doc
- [ ] Link to dashboards (if applicable)
- [ ] Quick sync 20m scheduled with new owner
```

mitra: these are crisp. can we add a 3-line self-review alt that emphasizes outcomes, collaborators, and ask?
lara: yes, alternate self-review format below (each line <=140 chars):

```
Alt self-review (3 lines):
1) Outcome: [what shipped] -> [impact in plain english]
2) Teamwork: [who you partnered with / unblock you led] -> [what improved]
3) Ask: [specific support, e.g., mentor, runway, prioritization change]
```

theo: i'll forward to eng managers and ask for 1-2 examples to populate the handbook page. jen: i can sanitize and add tone variants (formal / conversational).
jen: tiny note: avoid numeric overload in self-review; keep one strong metric or a clear qualitative outcome.
lar a: will publish as "manager microblocks — handoff + self-review" and link in the review form. thanks! :sparkles:
